company_info.company_description: "Passionate about solar, In Series always provides their customers with installations of the highest quality.In Series specialise in renewable and sustainable energy solutions. Their experienced in-house installation team prides themselves in delivering quality and cost effective solutions tailored to meet customers individual needs. Notable installs include a 100 kW installation on the Panorama Hotel and a 80 kW system on the Launceston Health Hub. Their loyal, friendly after-sales service is what sets them apart from the competition."

reviews.review_description: In Series made installing solar super easy.  From first contact to completion, everything went smoothly.

Quoting service excellentInstallation a little hiccup as they had wrong colour panels, but only 3 week delay to put onInstall went fineHow it works for us we obviously won’t know until over 12 months at least but can only go on what they recommend as they know more about Solar than us

Very personable salesman, quote was thorough and quality equipment promised.Installation was quick and easy, with a quality looking result.Everything was organised for me, I just had to sign it off after being taken through the system operation, the app, and next steps with the retailer
Everything was explained clearly to me and the whole order and installation process went seamlessly.Very competitive pricing.

Knowledgable, experience staff, good value for money system, and use gear that had been approved by Finn Peacock, which was comforting to know. Good poeple to deal with and followed up all the way through the process.

Quoting  process easy to understand . Install was seamless,on time neat and tidy, install crew brilliant customer service  throughout  the whole process was great they kept us in the loop at all times we never had to do a thing. Overall  an excellent  job would  have no problems  recommending the company  to other people
Sales was a bit pushy ti sell me what he wanted rather than focus on what I wanted and needed.Ongoing customer service was great.Service manual is a very week out together dedicated manual.

In Series provided several options at various price points for a solar system and backup battery at our rural Tasmania property. The installation was very nicely done, and our property left clean and tidy. Everyone at In Series were happy to answer questions and they have scheduled July 1 to return and commission our system to ensure we receive the federal government battery rebate. I would highly recommend In Series to anyone looking to install solar in Tasmania.
Quoting process was really flexible, with several options/prices explored with no fuss. Very knowledgeable sales advisor and installers were professional, polite and quick!

Of the 3 quotes, In Series was the first to quote. I asked many questions and they were all answered to my satisfaction. The installation was done promptly and I'm very happy to be saving money on my power bills. The only negative was I called them back to remove a racking offcut from the roof and there were wire offcuts and metal brackets dropped in my dog yard.

This is the 2nd PV system I have owned.My 1st PV system was when I lived in East Gippsland.Now I live in the West of Tasmania.A place where it used to rain a lot, now we just get dry lightning  :(I missed not having a PV system, especially when electricity prices were rising so much.I tried to get a PV system before, but being on a pension, no-one would give me the money.Now the government has a scheme, I can afford to go solar again  :)I chose In Series as they had a very good reputation in the business.They have been in business a long time, so they will be there when your inverter dies in a decades time.They were so easy to deal with, they handled all the paperwork, I did nothing, compared to my 1st install a decade ago.The 3 lads arrived early and went straight to workIt was a cooler day, thankfully, not in the 30s like the last few daysBut it felt like it was 28 when it was only 18!But there was a wind change on the wayIt took them less than 5 hours to install 14 Aiko panels on my roof &a 5kW Fronius inverter next to the meter boardThe fuse box is inside the houseThey did a really nice clean jobAll the cables were well hiddenThey cleaned up after themselvesThey even took the rubbish with themThen they drove back to LauncestonAn hour later, the cool change cameThat afternoon, I was standing outside looking at my Aiko'sand just smiling at them while I had how much they were producing on my mobileYes, I can monitor the system from my mobile because I got a Fronius inverterI can also do it from my computerI set-up a page on the computer & made a shortcut to the desktop so I can have it on any computerIf you want to follow my system, here is the link:-https://www.solarweb.com/PvSystems/PvSystem?pvSystemId=00c83be5-bb92-4111-a808-b3ce478711c6I recommend In Series Electrical, they did a fantastic job.  They are the quiet achievers in the PV installer industry.They do a # 1 job, but they don't brag about it, that is why they are silver, they just let the customers write reviews to sing their praisers; but how many customers actually do that after a job is finished?  Not many, customers only complain, not praise; which is what the world has turned into now.  Would I get In Series to install my PV system again?  Blood oath I would, in a heart beat, they did such a good job.  If you read their previous work like I did, it is all high praise for themAiko panels & Fronius inverter, that is what I settled on.  Fronius has been around for ages.  Aiko, they are the new kids on the block, or are they?  They used to make panels for other companies, now they decided to go alone, and Aiko is the name they trade their PV panels under.  Why do I say PV system all the time & not solar system?  A PV system is a photovoltaic system & the solar system is the planets circling around the sun.I used to have a 5kW system in my old place in the high country of Victoria & I miss it, so I was so glad that the Government has this interest free scheme over 3 years; I wish it was longer for pensioners.But I was doing ~44kWh when we had those sunny days early February, before the dry change came in.That is ~10kWh more than my place in the high country in Victoria used to do!That is unreal to do ~44kWh in a day in Tassie on a 5kW inverter.If I had a bigger inverter, it would have been higher, but I would have had to pay more for the bigger inverter5kW is the popular size, so it is the cheaper choiceI hope you have fun with your PV system, you always get obsessed with your 1st one!Is that cloud going to come overWill that tree grow too much & make shadeHow often do I have to clean it?Does it need cleaning?Get away from my panel bird, go shit somewhere elseetc          have a fun with      :)

I will use this company again.The marketing was honest, expertand polite, the process streamlined and the installation punctual and expertly done.The quotation was very well presented.The 'manual' of use provided after installation was comprehensive and tailored to our set-up.Relevant connections/interactions with third parties during system set-up went flawlessly.A model for the industry...

Every employee of the company that we dealt with was very professional, punctual, polite, got the job done on time, on price, which was fantastic. We're now experiencing wonderful free solar electricity and we look forward to a lengthy relationship with InSeries.
Sales/quoting process was great.Installation was quick and they did a great job.Service was good.Yes they helped with connection
Good service by company. From sales, quote and install. No issues to date
All involved were efficient, tidy and punctual.  Everything was explained clearly and connection was completed.

Des was excellent to deal with, providing knowledgeable and prompt advice throughout the quoting process. The installers were great - prompt, friendly and did a great job despite poor weather.The price was cheaper than a similar system from another installer, and appears relatively consistent with local pricing (dearer than mainland I believe, but good value).So far very satisfied with the service and performance of the system we have got, wish we'd done it years ago.13kw of panels with 10kw inverter appears to have been a good decision so far.
Very happy with the service and quality of products supplied.
Good job. Quick install. Good clean up and instruction on how to use

Bill came to discuss quotes and spent an hour at my home. He was so friendly and helpful. Didn't over quote me for example, a partial upgrade to meter box was required yet other places told me a full upgrade was required at double the price. They ensured panels were placed to get max benefit unlike other places I got quotes from. It included a hot water timer for free. They also had a lot of panels or inverters to choose from to suit your needs and budget, unlike other places.The communication was excellent and the boys that did the job were great. On time, and job done in 5 hours. Answered any questions and emailed to ensure I was happy with the installation.Highly recommended.

In Series Electrical contacted us within 48hrs, and were the only ones who contacted us in the first 2 weeks, from the 3 companies chosen by Solarquotes.We were very pleased with the deal offered, and the salesman was friendly, and down to earth.The installers were friendly and polite, turned up on time, tidied up after themselves, and we were given a rundown of the operation of the system and inverter once it was all operational.We are very happy with every aspect of our installation.
Very happy from site visit, sharing of information & education, quote, time line, communication, installation & follow up.
The installer was prompt, the discussion on our needs was thorough and frank, the pricing was good and fare and what was promised was supplied. Very happy with the professional level of service.

In series were the first to respond to my Solar Quotes enquiry. I received a phone call with a very friendly and knowledgeable representative. The process from the start was informative, personalised and financing seamless. We are now up and running with a Solar Edge system and I am extremely happy with the system everything that was discussed was delivered, on before time and on budget.

InSeries gave detailed quotes in a timely manner. The salesperson listened to our needs. They handled everything. Installation was completed seamlessly.  So very happy with the whole process. This company is great!

Bill the person giving quote gave us a detailed quote and sat with us to talk through what was involved. Installation was about 4 weeks after accepting quote and on day of installation the 3 workers were very friendly and efficient. They were mindful of making a mess after rain      They have notified our electricity provider of installation and we are waiting on them for final process.Overall I would recommend In Series for any solar panel installation. Great job.

Easy to deal with face to face sales/quoting processesExcellent customer service and communication processesInstallation was timely as scheduled, efficient and tidy.  Neat job on roof.Also efficient follow up, they advised power supplier of requirement for grid connection, no worry for us

Representative was punctual to quote on work.Quote was sent promptly and was detailed.Representative replied promptly to any queries I had.Tradesmen arrived on time and went about their work promptly.Tradesmen were polite and asked me for any information they needed.All rubbish related to the job was cleaned up thoroughly.The electrician helped me download the app to my phone.The company has filled in all of the required paperwork.Because I already had a small solar system the new system was able to connect to the grid and they have forwarded the request to connect to tariff 93 to Tas Networks.
From enquiry to installation,  the processhas been easy and gone through without a hitch. Great communication throughoutHighly recommend.

Warm, friendly & helpful sales team with a quote than came later the same day.Installation team were very professional going about their tasks, very polite & knowledgeableabout any questions I had at various times. After the install was completed, they organisedthe grid connection & explained the operation of the inverter, hot water timer and monitor system.

Does guys was very friendly and right on it.  Got back to me straight away with a range of options. Very efficient and tidy installation    Got to discuss some options with the sparky.  Only took about 6 hours.  Took me through the inverter operations.  Didn’t set the timer on it but I’ve done that.  Paid the company but haven’t heard back from them yet with a receipt.  Think the grid connection was lined up prior to the installation.

In series electrical was the first to get in touch with me and sent me 4 proposal’s. The next day they turned up to look at the job and discuss options, they even customised the system to suit my needs. The installation went smoothly and looks great.

Bill was very frank about the pros and cons of different system configurations, and helpfully directed me to additional information to address questions he didn't have immediate answers to. Bill and Des also appeared to work well as a team, and communications from Des were prompt and clear, providing exactly the information I needed to make a decision. Same goes for the installation team, who arrived on time, and delivered exactly as promised.Also, at no point was anyone from In Series pushy, which I greatly appreciated.

Quoting System was excellent, The sales consultant came prepared with a folder with all details and a overhead view of the roof with images of where the solar panels would be fitted.A very professional team who carried out a no fuss, quick high quality professional installation.They helped organise the grid connection and answered all my questions about tariffs and Aurora +I highly recommend them.Ray
Everything was fast and efficient. They took care of every detail.
Couldn’t be happier with my solar system from in series, Bill was great to deal with, installation was quick and easy and my power bills are a fraction of what they used to be.

We went with an install from In Series and are delighted with the result. I should also state that the quote from I Want Energy was competitive and their representative was also great. In the end we chose to go with In Series as they were more local and their installation was "in house". They could also offer an earlier install date. The installers were polite and efficient and communicated very well to educate us on the system and its features. The company handled all of the post install issues e.g. connection etc. Well Pleased
Very happy with the whole process from initial contact through to install. All completed in a very timely manner.
Brilliant from go to woah! Couldn’t do enough for us, generous with time, extras and consultation.

The In Series team were great from sales talk to installation. The installation was very professional, the lads were well-mannered and polite, and they left our place immaculate...no bits and pieces or rubbish, unlike other tradies we have had complete work.

Des was very prompt with his quote and it was the best priced. 4 guys showed up for the install which was done neatly and efficiently in about 3 hours. They tidied up afterwards and provided  good instruction on system usage.

I liked the professional way the company came across there prices were what I expected installers were great connecting to the grid a bit slow aurora's fault not in series.Overall everything went wellThanks for the recommendation

For a local solar company we could have not ask for better service. From sit down and discuss at home with Matt gower to Moretta the manager...The attention to detail for us to have solar was perfect...Even down to the selection of the panels ....we could not have asked for a more perfect transaction ...nothing was any trouble, and to the installation with In series electrical & solar co with minimal disruption very nice people...If I could do it again I wouldn't hesitate. We now have low to zero power bill .......we added 3.3kw to our existing system. Perfect+++++
